labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: a related records choice, the object and its parent field
Import: related records chosen under Insert, which has no parent key
labels.value: Related records need a parent key. Choose Upsert by external ID, Update by a field you choose or Update by record ID, or turn off related records.

labels.shortDescription: Import: the related object is not one a load can create records of
labels.value: Related records cannot be created in {0}. Choose another related object, or ask your Salesforce administrator for access to create them.

labels.shortDescription: Import: the related object's parent field does not point at the loaded object
labels.value: No field of {0} that you may fill in points at {1}. Choose the related records again.

labels.shortDescription: Import: a row's related record is not created because its parent was not saved
labels.value: The parent record of this row was not saved, so its related record was not created. Fix the first row with this key, then load these rows again.

labels.shortDescription: Import: a row's related record was refused; its parent stays
labels.value: The related record was not saved: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: a column mapped to the related record's parent field is skipped
labels.value: {0} is filled in with each row's parent, so the column mapped to it is not loaded.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: how many related records the commit created and did not
Import run log: how many related records the dry run would create and would not
labels.value: Related records: {0} would be created, {1} would not.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: a related record's field in the column picker
Import wizard: the related records picker
Import wizard: what related records do
labels.value: Each row can also create a record that points at its parent, such as a session of a program. Rows with the same value in the field rows are matched by share one parent. Then map the related columns on the columns step.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: why Insert offers no related records
labels.value: To load related records, choose Upsert by external ID or one of the updates, so rows can name their parent by a key.
